advisory_title: fastify vulnerable to X-Forwarded-* spoofing under trustProxy hop-count
hole: A numeric trustProxy setting trusts X-Forwarded-* entries by hop count without checking the immediate peer, so a direct client can add enough forwarded hops to spoof its IP, host and protocol.

advisory_title: Crabbox: authentication bypass vulnerability that allows impersonation of others by spoofing identity headers
hole: A caller with the shared (non-admin) bearer token gets its owner and org from the x-crabbox-owner and x-crabbox-org request headers, so it can act as any other owner or organization.

advisory_title: Skipper has OPA body-authz bypass: truncated_body mitigation fails open on chunked/HTTP-2 (incomplete fix GHSA-8qqm-fp2q-v734)
hole: When a request body is chunked or sent over HTTP/2 and is larger than the buffer, the policy check sees only the first part and is never told the body was cut, so a policy that inspects the body can be passed by putting the forbidden content past the limit.

advisory_title: 9router: Kiro region injection allows authenticated SSRF with Authorization header forwarding
hole: The Kiro sign-in flow puts a caller-supplied region straight into the upstream host name (oidc.<region>.amazonaws.com), so a crafted region sends the request, with its credentials, to a host the caller picks.

advisory_title: Assisted Migration Agent: Path traversal in gzipped tarball handling enables arbitrary file write and remote code execution
hole: Tarball extraction checks each entry's path by name only and does not resolve symlinks it already created, so an entry under a symlink pointing at .. writes files outside the extraction folder.

advisory_title: pyLoad: Rate-Limit Bypass and Audit-Log Spoofing via Trusted Client-Controlled `X-Forwarded-For` Header
hole: The login rate limit, API key checks and sign-in audit log take the client IP from the X-Forwarded-For header any caller can set, so an attacker gets a fresh rate-limit bucket per request and can forge the logged IP.

advisory_title: Casdoor: GetTokenExchangeToken bypass through lack of cross-organization JWT signature check
hole: Token exchange checks the subject token's signature with the requesting application's certificate and never checks the token's audience, so a token from one application or organization can be exchanged for a token of another.

advisory_title: Mercury: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in /api/terminals - access control bypass
hole: A missing comma joins two entries of the blocked-path list, so /api/terminals is not blocked and anyone can open a server shell without signing in.

advisory_title: Kerberos Hub private key (X-Kerberos-Hub-PrivateKey) leaked to cross-host redirect target due to redirect-following HTTP client without CheckRedirect
hole: The Hub upload sends the private key in a custom header with an HTTP client that follows redirects, and Go only strips standard auth headers on a cross-host redirect, so the key goes to whatever host the Hub URL redirects to.

advisory_title: Jupyter server on Windows discloses Windows user password hash
hole: The static file finder accepts absolute paths and checks they exist before checking they are inside the served folder, so on Windows a request for a UNC path makes the server connect out and hand over the user's password hash.

advisory_title: netlicensing-mcp: REST Path Traversal Bypasses Token Redaction
hole: Tool arguments from the model are pasted into REST paths, so an id of ../token reaches the token endpoint and skips the tool's API-key redaction, leaking the key to the model.

advisory_title: simple-git Affected by Command Execution via Option-Parsing Bypass
hole: The unsafe-option guard blocks clone's -u (upload-pack) switch only in its plain form, so combined short flags like -vu or other spellings still pass a command for git to run.

advisory_title: Aegra has cross-user run injection in /threads/{thread_id}/runs (IDOR)
hole: Creating a run on a thread never checks that the thread belongs to the caller, so any signed-in user can start runs on another user's thread.

advisory_title: Thumbor has HMAC validation bypass via multiple .replace() calls when removing URL signature
hole: The URL signature check strips the signature with str.replace, which removes every copy, so an attacker can put the valid signature elsewhere in a different URL and have it validate.

advisory_title: goshs: File-based .goshs ACL authorization bypass via the ?bulk zip-download route (unauthenticated read; residual of GHSA-wvhv-qcqf-f3cx)
hole: The bulk zip download checks only that each path stays in the web root, not the per-folder .goshs access rules, so files those rules protect or block can be downloaded without credentials.

advisory_title: Qinglong has an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-3965: Improper Authentication
hole: The guard that blocks re-running first-time setup checks only /api/user/init, while /open/user/init skips sign-in and is rewritten to the same handler, so anyone can reset the admin login.

advisory_title: qbee-agent: Docker Compose build context Zip Slip writes outside context directory
hole: Tar extraction checks the target path with a plain string prefix, so an entry like ../context-evil/x (a sibling folder sharing the prefix) is written outside the destination.

advisory_title: listmonk: SQL Injection in `/api/subscribers/export` bypasses table access control, leaking admin password hashes and SMTP credentials
hole: The subscriber export runs the caller's SQL filter without the table allowlist check the search path applies, so a user allowed to filter by SQL can read any table, including admin password hashes and mail settings.

advisory_title: Hono: API Gateway v1 adapter can drop a distinct repeated request header value during de-duplication
hole: The API Gateway v1 adapter drops a repeated header value when it is a substring of a value already set, so the app sees a different header list than the gateway forwarded.

advisory_title: i18next-http-backend incomplete URL validation permits SSRF
hole: The language and namespace checks allow ':' and '//', so when the load path starts with the placeholder a value like http:127.0.0.1:8080 turns the request URL into one on another host.
